title: We had a really great day...
text: We had a really great day with Roman as our guide. He was so knowledgeable and interesting. Beautiful places to visit. It’s a long day with an early start but worth it. Highly recommend.
author: Joanna_H

title: Great show
text: The cave was a little tough to find but it was worth it. The music and dance were amazing and the food was plentiful and very good and they accommodated vegetarians.
author: Lisa_P

title: Perfect night
text:
Such a fun event! The cave is the perfect bd stop. Food was great and the entertainment was top shelf. Maria is absolutely beautiful
And Cesar on the guitar is amazing.
author: kyle_m

title: Flamenco in Sacramonte, Granada
text: Difficult to locate the venue. No signage. Taxi didn’t know where to drop us off. Otherwise, a great experience.
author: Deborah_R

title: Authentic flamenco
text: The perfect place to experience authentic flamenco in Granada, in a cave in Sacramento where it all began. Raw, exuberant, explosive performances that occasionally softened with beautiful solo performances from the guitarist. Food and drinks were also good.
author: Tina_S

title: Excellent
text:
Brilliant show!! All the dancers were excellent and the guitarist was absolutely brilliant!!
Would definitely recommend.
author: Dedebopper

title: Great flamenco show!
text:
This was a great experience. The flamenco dancers, singer, and guitarist were spectacular. And it is such a unique intimate place. 
The tapas and drinks were great.
author: Jaime_C

title: Passionate music & dancing to energize you
text: This hidden gem is SO worth it! We arrived in Granada shortly before the show and went exhausted, but we left energized. We opted for the tapas option and food was incredible! The passionate music & dancing was far beyond what we could imagine. The cave carried the sounds and wonder of everything flamenco.  Though we got a ride to the venue (it is uphill), we walked back (easily) into the city. It was after 11pm but there was so much life in Granada! Staff was extremely friendly, attentive & patient with our emergent Spanish. Highly recommended evening!
author: Traci_C

title: Give yourself plenty of...
text: Give yourself plenty of spare time to find the venue,  very difficult to find. An amazing experience. I have seen a few Flamenco shows but the sound amplified from being in a cave which made it quite magnificent.  I would recommend for the organisers to perhaps out a blackboard at the lower steps to help either the directions.
author: Peter_S

title: First flamenco experience
text:
The location was off the beaten track, which was great. The service was wonderful.
 In a beautiful cave. The show started on time. The show is incredible with intense professional dancers. Enjoyed it immensely.
author: Marlene_H
